editorial: Automation skills and systematic trading strategies in software development processes constitute the main agenda of the developer community today. The copilot development kit (copilot sdk) shared by Microsoft clearly reveals the standardization trend of artificial intelligence integrated tools.

items.title: zhaoxuya520/reverse-skill
items.summary: Reverse-skill offers an artificial intelligence-supported routing package for reverse engineering and penetration testing processes. With its toolchain bootstrapping and self-developing knowledge base features, Claude Code integrates with coding tools such as Cursor and Cline.

items.title: different-ai/openwork
items.summary: Openwork is a software development tool that was developed as an open source alternative to the Claude Cowork platform and uses the opencode infrastructure. Prepared with TypeScript, the project aims to bring autonomous coding processes to the open source ecosystem.

items.title: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.summary: Last30days-skill offers an artificial intelligence skill (AI agent skill) that creates summaries about complex topics by scanning current data from platforms such as Reddit, X, YouTube and Hacker News. This Python-based tool combines information from different sources to produce evidence-based syntheses for users.

items.title: paperswithbacktest/awesome-systematic-trading
items.summary: Bringing together libraries, strategies, books and educational resources for systematic trading processes, this list gathers Python-based financial modeling tools at a central point. It serves as a comprehensive reference library for developers entering the world of algorithmic trading.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: Prepared by Microsoft, AI-For-Beginners offers a comprehensive artificial intelligence training program consisting of a 12-week curriculum and 24 lessons. This open source project, carried out through Jupyter Notebooks, provides participants with hands-on learning opportunities, starting from the basic level.

items.title: github/copilot-sdk
items.summary: GitHub has released a multiplatform software development kit (SDK) that allows developers to integrate Copilot agents into their own applications and services. This tool allows artificial intelligence-supported workflows to be included in the system with a standard structure in Java-based projects.

items.title: chatwoot/chatwoot
items.summary: Chatwoot is an open source platform that offers live chat, email support and omni-channel customer service management. Developed as an alternative to software such as Intercom and Zendesk, this tool allows centralizing customer interactions through a single panel.

items.title: agavra/tuicr
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, tuicr offers a terminal-based code review interface with support for Vim keybindings. It allows software developers to manage code review processes without leaving the terminal environment.

items.title: usekaneo/kaneo
items.summary: Kaneo is an open source project management tool developed with a user-oriented interface. Written in TypeScript, the platform aims to create complexity-free workflows.

items.title: geo-tp/ESP32-Bit-Pirate
items.summary: ESP32-Bit-Pirate is a hardware hacking tool that supports multiple communication protocols via a web-based command line interface (CLI). This system, developed in C++ language, facilitates hardware analysis processes by managing different protocols on a single platform.

items.title: deepfakes/faceswap
items.summary: Faceswap is an open source software that performs face swapping operations on videos and photos with its Python-based structure. It allows users to transform faces on visual content using deep learning techniques.

items.title: 1jehuang/jcode
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, jcode offers a code processing tool (harness) that minimizes memory usage. This structure, designed to efficiently manage system resources in software processes, provides high-performance code execution environments.

items.title: Elevators
items.summary: This study examines the operating logic and floor selection algorithms of elevators and focuses on efficiency optimization in vertical transportation systems. It analyzes distributed control strategies that reduce waiting times and save energy through software-based simulations.

items.title: qm – Multiplayer agent harness for work
items.summary: qm offers an infrastructure that provides collaboration and task management for multiplayer AI agents. This tool allows different agents to execute tasks simultaneously in a shared workspace.

items.title: Tailscale didn't stop the Hugging Face intrusion
items.summary: The unauthorized access incident on Hugging Face shows that using a secure network (mesh VPN) alone is not enough to ensure system security. When secure network solutions are not supported by layered security measures such as authentication and access control, vulnerabilities may occur.

items.title: Twenty-five years ago it was cryptography, today it's model weights
items.summary: The open source discussions that took place in the field of cryptography twenty-five years ago are being repeated today around the accessibility of artificial intelligence model weights. The world of technology is redefining the boundaries between open access and closed systems in order to balance security and innovation.

items.title: Big Food vs. the People
items.summary: The research, conducted by Lighthouse Reports, examines the lobbying efforts of major food companies to influence nutrition policies and their pressure on scientific data. The study provides concrete evidence of the strategies the food industry uses to circumvent public health regulations.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3
items.summary: Developed by Moonshot AI, Kimi-K3 is a multimodal model that produces text-based outputs by processing visual and text inputs. The system offers the ability to analyze complex visual data and create meaningful text based on this data.

items.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 is a language model optimized for text generation tasks. It supports large-scale language processing with its low latency and high efficiency oriented architecture.

items.title: DavidAU/Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion-711-Uncensored-Heretic-NM-DAU-NEO-MAX-MTP-GGUF
items.summary: The Qwen3.6-27B-Fable-Fusion model is a multimodal artificial intelligence model that extends image-to-text capabilities. Thanks to its uncensored structure and optimized GGUF format, it provides high-performance text generation on local hardware.

items.title: baidu/Unlimited-OCR
items.summary: Unlimited-OCR, developed by Baidu, is a model that performs image-based text recognition (image-text-to-text) operations. It offers the ability to process the texts in the image and convert them into text-based outputs.

items.title: owensong/Inflect-Micro-v2
items.summary: Inflect-Micro-v2 is a model developed for text-to-speech operations. It is designed to support high-quality sound synthesis processes with low resource consumption.
